subject: Re: NAM kickoff — resourcing + June sweep reservation
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Wanjiru leads the library work, Jorge the sweep harness, Oyin the customer integration path. The run.sh test script from the release is already wired into our CI as a sanity gate.

Compute — the per-dataset-family sweeps are wide (feature-net depth/width, dropout, feature-sparsity regularizer, output penalty... crossed with ~10 datasets and 20 splits each). Individually small models, but the matrix is enormous, so we're batching it into one reserved week: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation, 512 accelerators, for the week of 2026-06-22. Ines flagged the cluster maintenance window ending 06-24, and has us starting Wednesday of that week at full 512 — the sweep fits in four days with margin since each job is tiny.

Everything pre-June runs titan-a100 best-effort.

MIMIC-II: blocked on the DUA per your note; sweep plan treats it as optional.

Jelena
